title: YUZUKI gold evaluation set manifest
description: User-supplied Japanese clips with reference transcript and translation. Audio is never committed; see fixtures/gold/README.md and docs/09-security-rights.md.

translation_language.description: BCP 47 tag of every reference_translation (e.g. zh-Hans, en).

audio.description: Path relative to fixtures/gold/ (e.g. audio/clip01.wav). The audio/ folder is git-ignored.

reference_transcript.description: Verbatim human transcript. One string per clip; sentences may be separated by newlines (used as translation-judge units).

reference_translation.description: Human reference translation, sentence-aligned line by line with reference_transcript.

rights.description: Mandatory per docs/09-security-rights.md: only owned or clearly licensed audio; no real-person voice without the permission appropriate to evaluation use.

license.description: user-owned = recorded/created by the user; otherwise an SPDX id of an open license, or 'permission' with consent_reference.

source.description: Where the audio came from (URL, recording session, dataset name and version).

evaluation_permitted.description: Must be true: the rights holder allows use for local quality evaluation.

real_person_voice.description: none = synthetic or the user's own voice; consented = an identifiable real person who granted permission for this use.

consent_reference.description: Where the written permission is kept (not the permission itself).
